notes.title: Free to play
notes.content:
Thanks to the ones who have supported the game and left their valuable feedback.

We’d love to share the game to all who’d like to try it free of charge. 

If you need anything please reach out in the discussion or comments here. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Launch & upcoming roadmap!
notes.content:
[b]Features Coming Soon[/b]

[olist]
[*] New tower placement System
[*] More mobs
[*] Different maps
[*] Different Helpers
[*] Additional Settings 
[*] Steam Leaderboard

[/olist]

[b]Thanks![/b]
